text: The death toll from the ferry disaster on Zimbabwe’s Lake Kariba has risen to 68 after 22 more bodies were recovered, police say. The overloaded vessel, carrying more passengers than its authorised capacity, capsized in choppy waters earlier this week.#LakeKariba#Zimbabwe
translated_text: 警方称，在津巴布韦卡里巴湖渡轮事故中又找到 22 具尸体后，死亡人数已上升至 68 人。这艘超载的船只运载的乘客超过其授权容量，本周早些时候在波涛汹涌的水域中倾覆。#卡里巴湖#津巴布韦
